description: Create comprehensive README.md with deployment instructions for GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify, and customization guides for meme image, memory photos, and nickname changes.
steps: Replace the existing README.md with a comprehensive production-ready README that includes: Project title and description (Operation Maaf Karo 1/5 Footiya), Features list, Tech stack, File structure diagram, Deployment instructions for GitHub Pages (Settings > Pages > Deploy from branch), Vercel (import repo, no build command needed, publish directory ./), Netlify (drag and drop or connect repo, no build command, publish directory ./), How to replace meme image (drop file into images/final-meme.jpg or .gif), How to replace memory photos (add memory1-5.jpg to images/), How to change nickname (search and replace '1/5 Footiya' in index.html and script.js), Security features list, License section
acceptance_criteria: README.md exists with all deployment instructions
GitHub Pages deployment steps are clear and complete

Run: grep -c 'Vercel' /projects/sandbox/ask-for-sorry-/README.md to confirm Vercel section
Run: grep -c 'Netlify' /projects/sandbox/ask-for-sorry-/README.md to confirm Netlify section
